text: In the near future, a young Emirati couple [returns to their home country|trigger|going back home] and moves into a high-rise apartment in Ras al-Khaimah, where they come to suspect that [their neighbours may not be human|images|ghosts and strange figures]. The tower stands on [the site of an abandoned fishing village|origin|places with dark pasts], and in flashbacks an American backpacker passing through that village hears local Emiratis tell him about the djinn.
